name: Jeholopterus
sum: Fuzzy anurognathid from the Daohugou beds of Inner Mongolia, China, preserved with a halo of pycnofibres.
holotype: IVPP V12705 — Daohugou beds (Tiaojishan Formation), Ningcheng, Inner Mongolia.
material: Nearly complete crushed skeleton on slab and counterslab.
exceptional: Carbonised skin fibres, pycnofibres and wing tissue; a possible Cretaceous specimen from North Korea.
biology: Very broad mouth with peg-like and recurved teeth; anurognathids are considered insectivores, though Jeholopterus, the largest, may also have eaten fish.
author: Wang et al. 2002
